config.trace_scope: One complete native prepare + prepared solve + JSON serialization. Python tracemalloc excludes the native subprocess, compiler, and RSS; it measures Python-side allocations only. Native wall time includes Python guard-context setup and native metadata serialization; Python baseline serializes only the solver result.

split_pair_derivation.rationale: One global suit bijection maps AsKh to AsKc and leaves QdQs unchanged; it gives a bijection of the 1,712,304 legal unordered boards and preserves all poker ranks. This is a derivation from the pinned physical count, not a fresh independent enumeration.

method.timing: Complete prepare + solve_prepared_push_fold + JSON serialization; GC collection occurs before each timed call. Native calls include Python ranker guard instrumentation and serialize preparation metadata; Python baseline serializes only the solver result. Python baseline uses no progress callback; stage-level progress I/O runs outside both timed intervals.
method.comparison: Exact native output dictionary equality against a reference immutable table assembled from pinned independent PR125 W/T/L rows and the current exact-preflight priors. Three additional fresh Python complete calls are interleaved with native base-case calls in alternating order.
method.oracle: PR125 physical counts were independently produced with scripts.preflop_validation.independent_rank. Split AsKc uses the recorded global c<->h suit-bijection derivation. This benchmark re-enumerates native and reference production boards, but does not rerun the independent physical oracle.
method.quality: Every result is replayed by scripts.preflop_push_fold_validation.replay and checked against an exact weighted equilibrium witness; all scalar replay gaps must be <= 1e-10 and final exploitability/value error plus 1e-10 padding must be <= 0.005 chips.
method.retention: All measured call samples, parity comparisons, and quality misses are retained; expected quality misses do not abort later samples.
method.scope: Optional native exact full-board equity preparation for the finite heads-up SB fold/shove and BB fold/call game only. No unrestricted NLHE, profitability, native training, or general ranker speed claim.

plan_budget.scope: Exact unordered five-card boards per compatible private pair; logical counts, not time or memory guarantees.

equity_preparation.scope: Exact unordered five-card boards per compatible private pair; logical counts, not time or memory guarantees.

solve_admission.scope: Conservative bookkeeping and generic-CFR/reference diagnostic loop entries for the fixed two-decision tree; source preparation is charged even when an immutable table is reused. Internal ranking instructions and caller progress callbacks are excluded; total rank calls have a separate pre-enumeration cap. Not bytecode, elapsed time, allocated bytes or RSS bounds.

exact_fraction_replay.normalization: each action row normalized by its exact fraction sum
